change_summary: Nov 9 now shows what was actually done: power clean 135 lb, back squat 4x10 at 155 lb, RDL about 155 lb. Adds low-fatigue core to Tue/Thu (hollow hold, side plank, hanging leg raise, McGill Big 3 holds), penultimate-step cone reps on Saturday jump days, and a back-soreness rule (belt squat swap, easy walks) on lift days. Lifts for Nov 11-22 are unchanged from version 3. Power clean held at 135 lb for Nov 11-22 (athlete did 135 lb 5x4 all week 1). Week 2 back squat set to 4x9 at 160 lb. Back squats use regular tempo (no 3 s lowering). Lying hamstring curl set to about 70-75 lb for 3x10 (athlete went too heavy at 85 lb). Nov 16 logged as done (clean 135, squat 4x9 at 160, RDL 3x10 at 155; knee 1-2/10). Nov 18 squat 4x9 at 160 and hip thrust 3x10 logged. Nov 20 squat gets a 2-3 s lowering cue.

profile_snapshot.goal: Dunk off two feet. Approach vertical about 31-33 in, standing reach about 7 ft 2-3 in (needs roughly 10 ft 6 in touch). Back squat is a deep squat; half squat estimated.

knee_pain.notes: Knee pain in the past, now manageable.

profile_snapshot.injury_notes: Two-foot jumper. No sport or other jump load during the week. Bodyweight about 140 lb. Power clean max estimated about 185 lb (175 lb for 2 reps); half squat estimated about 250 lb. Standing vertical estimated 28-29 in.

mesocycles.name: Month 1 – volume building
mesocycles.goal: Build work capacity with general work that looks little like jumping; unload in week 4.
mesocycles.exit_criteria: Four weeks done, including the week-4 unload.
mesocycles.primes_next: Volume built here is intensified in month 2.

mesocycles.name: Month 2 – intensify, more specific
mesocycles.goal: Intensify the month-1 volume with clean pulls and power cleans; heavier RDL and calf raise accessories prime month 3.
mesocycles.primes_next: Heavier accessories (RDL, calf raise at 4–6 reps) lead into the absolute-strength month.

mesocycles.name: Month 3 – absolute strength
mesocycles.goal: Heavy squats and heavy clean pulls; eccentric accessories prime month 4.
mesocycles.primes_next: Eccentric accessories (Nordics, 2-up-1-down calf raises) lead into the eccentric main lifts of month 4.

mesocycles.name: Month 4 – strength-speed
mesocycles.goal: Power clean to maxes; accentuated eccentric squats and eccentric split squats; general days get more general.
mesocycles.primes_next: Elastic accessories (high-velocity calf raises, drop RDLs) lead into month 5's speed work.

mesocycles.name: Month 5 – speed-strength
mesocycles.goal: Move bars fast (lighter cleans, power snatch, hang cleans); blend a heavy squat primer with high-velocity squats; start shock loading at low plyo volume.
mesocycles.primes_next: Shock-loading accessories (med ball throws, low plyo volume) lead into month 6.

mesocycles.name: Month 6 – specificity
mesocycles.goal: Specificity at its highest, with the most plyo intensity and variety of the year; accessories become general and slow.
mesocycles.primes_next: Taper, if an event is set.
